split: sort allocation indices by mixSeed(dealSeed XOR index), floor(n/2) train, rest test; train win ties prefer analytic higher-pass choice
finding: Independent seed replication of split-trained win-choice versus analytic next-pass; interpret held-out effect only, not train gain. See atLeastEightWorlds and changedSeeds.
confidence: Model-only; position-level exploratory CIs; no claim of general human-play advantage without replication.
limitations: Uniform exact hidden allocations not conditioned on observed pass history; first-eligible selection, assumed branch semantics, deterministic bots, small per-position train/test, block winner unassigned.
exactNext: Enrich >=8-world disagreement positions with pass-history-conditioned posterior, then replicate on fresh seed sets and test minus-sensitive tie-break.
